notes.about: Telugu, in a script the engine has no rules of its own for: this file is all it knows. Sources: data/manifests/tewiki.json, tewikisource.json, tewikiquote.json, aksharantar-tel.json.
notes.notWord: The digits ౦-౯, and the siddham sign, the fraction digits and the tuumu sign (U+0C77 to U+0C7F).
notes.firstLetter: Independent vowels, consonants, ౘ ౙ ౚ and ౠ ౡ. Never a sign, the anusvara (ం), candrabindu or visarga.
notes.signs: Vowel signs, the length marks and the virama must follow a consonant. ం ఁ ః are left out: they can follow an independent vowel (అం, అః).
notes.joiners: A ZWNJ between the virama and the next letter is part of the word: Telugu writes loanwords with a visible virama (సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్, ఆన్‌లైన్, ఫేస్‌బుక్), and without the joiner the two consonants fuse into a conjunct (ఆన్లైన్), which reads as a mistake. The lexicon is built with them kept, so the pack needs engine 6.
notes.replace: None. ె + the ai length mark (U+0C56) is ై by NFC, which the normal form already applies.
notes.phraseBreaks: Telugu ends sentences with Latin punctuation; the dandas are listed for verse.
